what_could_weaken_view: SDNY securities fraud litigation reveals ASPI made materially false claims about uranium enrichment capability — QE has never been tested on UF6; HALEU thesis collapses into a small isotope enrichment story at 10-15x lower valuations
Si-28 and Yb-176 commercial shipments miss Q3 2026 / mid-2026 targets again — second consecutive slip signals deeper engineering challenges in ASP/QE processes

South African NNR uranium enrichment license not filed or denied — Pelindaba pre-implementation agreement is a planning contract, not a license; nuclear licensing typically 7-15 years for novel technologies
TerraPower conditional loan never disbursed — implies licensing not progressing; $375M supply agreement remains on paper indefinitely
Renergen Phase 1 helium misses nameplate capacity in Q3 2026 — delays the only near-term cash-flow catalyst; Phase 2 timeline (44 months post-Phase 1) slips correspondingly
Centrus $900M DOE expansion captures all near-term US HALEU demand by 2029 — US customers prefer NRC-licensed domestic supply over South African production
